title: Nerf Breach Level
description: Decreases the maximum level of breach to 2.
body:
# Purpose
The purpose of this datapack is to limit the maximum level of Breach to 2 (Vanilla = 4).

**Important: This datapack will not change the enchantments of existing maces.**

**This datapack should ideally be used at world creation.**

# Instructions:
1. Put the datapack in the datapacks folder
2. Enable the datapack by running /datapack enable "file/Nerf_Breach_Level"
3. Restart the world/server

Existing maces on the server or want to halve the effect of the enchantment instead?

[Get the Effect Nerf version here](https://modrinth.com/project/iiY02bHj)

Want to remove the mace instead?
[No Heavy Core](https://modrinth.com/project/10jJZvyv)
